topic: What would happen if all oceans turned to freshwater?

scenario.clickbait_title: ALL OCEANS TURNED FRESHWATER. Your City DIES FIRST.
youtube_tags: what if all oceans turn to freshwater
scenario.seo_description: What if ALL oceans turned to freshwater? Your city's marine life would instantly burst. Dive into a terrifying scenario where ocean currents vanish, global climates collapse, and Earth faces an unprecedented freshwater shock.
scenario.title: When Oceans Turn Fresh: A Global Collapse
scenario.thumbnail_concept: A massive, photorealistic pile of dead, bloated fish covering a city beach, with skyscrapers in the background, under a dramatic, stormy sky. Vertical composition, high contrast, immediate shock.

scenes.narration: Your city's marine life just started dying. Millions of fish cells, overloaded with freshwater, simply burst. Coastal cities are choked with mountains of dead, rotting sea creatures.
scenes.visual_prompt: VERTICAL COMPOSITION. Extreme close-up of a massive, bloated, dead fish (e.g., a tuna or shark) on a dark, wet city beach, its skin visibly ruptured. Behind it, a blur of countless more dead fish stretching to the horizon, with a dark, storm-laden sky above a coastal city skyline. Cinematic lighting, dramatic atmosphere, 8K detail, photorealistic.
scenes.twist_element: The visceral shock of immediate mass marine death.

scenes.narration: But the dying fish are just the beginning. Without salt, ocean currents vanish. Global heat redistribution grinds to a halt, triggering instant superstorms and climate chaos.
scenes.visual_prompt: VERTICAL COMPOSITION. A terrifying, towering supercell thunderstorm, glowing with internal lightning, churning over a vast, unnaturally still, dark ocean. Debris from distant storms floats on the surface. Camera pushes into the eye of the storm. Cinematic lighting, dramatic atmosphere, 8K detail, photorealistic.

scenes.narration: Think storms are the problem? Roli here. I've seen this timeline. Freshwater oceans freeze far easier. Massive ice sheets rapidly spread, consuming vast coastal cities.
scenes.visual_prompt: VERTICAL COMPOSITION. Roli, the photorealistic anthropomorphic rabbit scientist in a worn brass-and-leather steampunk spacesuit with goggles on his forehead and amber eyes, stands calmly in the foreground. He holds a glowing blue pocket-watch. Behind him, a massive, rapidly advancing wall of jagged, blue-white ice consumes a partially submerged modern cityscape. Cinematic lighting, dramatic atmosphere, 8K detail, photorealistic.

scenes.narration: Cities vanish under glaciers. Sea levels plummet globally. Remaining water evaporates, accelerating a deadly cycle of freezing and floods, endlessly repeating the initial shock.
scenes.visual_prompt: VERTICAL COMPOSITION. A desolate, frozen landscape. Towering, jagged glaciers loom over the ruins of a once-bustling coastal city, now almost entirely encased in ice. A thin, vaporous mist rises from cracks in the ice. Camera slowly pans over the frozen expanse. Cinematic lighting, dramatic atmosphere, 8K detail, photorealistic.
